svg.title: Preserve Runway Before Expanding Option Exposure
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Preserve Runway Before Expanding Option Exposure; subtitle: Four buckets total a $30,000 startup plan inside the $10,000–$50,000 range.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values encode the $30,000 reference allocation. Each detail also supplies lean and expanded allocations totaling $10,000 and $50,000 respectively. These are starting cash envelopes, not annual expenses or funding for land acquisition, construction, or major utility deposits.; caption: Do not spend the entire startup reserve on option premiums; a 2–6 month first-deal cycle requires explicit runway planning.; stages: label: Parcel intelligence and sourcing; value: $4,500 reference allocation for targeted evidence gathering; numeric value: 4500.0; detail: Lean $1,500; reference $4,500; expanded $7,500. Fund parcel records, targeted outreach, GIS support, and corridor verification. Prioritize public utility and county sources before purchasing broad datasets that cannot establish site-specific power availability.; label: Rights and initial diligence; value: $7,500 reference allocation for essential specialist investigation; numeric value: 7500.0; detail: Lean $2,500; reference $7,500; expanded $12,500. Fund initial counsel, title research, utility consultation, and land-use investigation. Full interconnection studies and extensive fieldwork need separately committed funding beyond this initial envelope.; label: Contingent option fee exposure; value: $6,000 reference allocation for tightly limited site control; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Lean $2,000; reference $6,000; expanded $10,000. Cap initial nonrefundable fees and negotiate staged payments with diligence exits. This startup exposure is separate from the mature Base annual $48,000 expired-option expense allowance.; label: Operating runway reserve; value: $12,000 reference allocation for preserved operating liquidity; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Lean $4,000; reference $12,000; expanded $20,000. At $1,800 monthly overhead, $12,000 covers about 6.7 months; at $11,000 it covers about 1.1 months. Reduce burn or secure additional committed capital before adopting the Base cost structure.

rect.title: label: Parcel intelligence and sourcing; numeric value: 4500.0; value: $4,500 reference allocation for targeted evidence gathering; detail: Lean $1,500; reference $4,500; expanded $7,500. Fund parcel records, targeted outreach, GIS support, and corridor verification. Prioritize public utility and county sources before purchasing broad datasets that cannot establish site-specific power availability.

Full interconnection studies and extensive fieldwork need separately committed funding beyond this initial envelope.
